title: Mewtwo's Mega Forms Split on Size
premise: Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y split dramatically on height and weight.
audiencePromise: See how Mewtwo's Mega forms turn one body into two opposite physical builds.
openLoop: How can Mewtwo's Mega forms split so far in size?
payoff: Mega Mewtwo X is 2.3 meters and 127 kilograms. Y is 1.5 meters and 33 kilograms.
engagementQuestion: Which feels more like Mewtwo: towering X or light Y?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a surprising comparison. Start sharp, then build curious tension. Stress the height and weight contrasts. Keep the pace quick, warm, and clear, with a brief pause before the final choice.

scenes.headline: TWO MEGAS. OPPOSITE SIZES.
scenes.narration: Mega X towers; Y weighs just 33 kilograms.
scenes.caption: THEY SPLIT ON SIZE

scenes.headline: X GOES BIG
scenes.narration: Mega Mewtwo X rises to 2.3 meters and weighs 127 kilograms.
scenes.caption: 2.3 METERS • 127 KILOGRAMS

scenes.headline: Y GOES LIGHT
scenes.narration: Mega Mewtwo Y stands 1.5 meters tall, weighing 33 kilograms.
scenes.caption: 1.5 METERS • 33 KILOGRAMS

scenes.headline: ONE BODY, TWO DIRECTIONS
scenes.narration: X moves above Mewtwo's height; Y drops below it.
scenes.caption: X: 2.3 METERS • BASE: 2 METERS • Y: 1.5

scenes.headline: WEIGHT MAKES IT STRANGER
scenes.narration: The stranger split is weight: Y weighs 33 kilograms against X's 127.
scenes.caption: 33 KILOGRAMS VS 127

scenes.headline: THE DESIGN FORKS
scenes.narration: Mega X at 127 kilograms, or Mega Y at 33?
scenes.caption: PICK YOUR MEGA MEWTWO
